answer: Pay agents by join cohort. Everyone who registers in the same epoch shares a fixed pot, say 1,000 POA per epoch, split among passing members, and one funding cluster may take at most 10% of any cohort pot. A farmer who can forge 50 clones in one window still collects at most 100 POA, so every clone past the cap earns zero; the extra keys just pile up like shale on a slab that never grows. Spreading clones over 50 windows costs 50 epochs (~12 days) of waiting. Check: cohort sizes and cluster shares are public each close, so a swollen cohort shows like a crack in opal.
